method: Each verdict and message was measured on a copy of web-ide's simulator/src at this SHA, with the dependency versions its package-lock.json pins (ohm-js 17.2.1, @davidsouther/jiffies 2.2.5), run under tsx. Each shape goes through HDL.parse and then build, with no file system, so a part that is not a builtin is "Undefined chip name". grammar: HDL.parse refuses it (languages/grammars/hdl.ohm). build: build refuses it (chip/builder.ts, chip/chip.ts). accept: it builds. message: the CompilationError message, "Line N:" included. A wire statement is spec-only (ADR-0020 §1.10.6), so the grammar refuses every shape that holds one.

sources.#725: issuecomment-6184961559: the 26-shape table, the tag scan and the part-id comments
sources.#740: issuecomment-6188266196: the probe table and the re-measured rows; its two multi-file rows (A uses B uses A, Not.hdl beside And.hdl) need a registry of user chips and are not here
sources.#732: issuecomment-6186263400: "_" and Unicode letters in names, a buffer named like its chip, the header lists, capitalised and wide literals
sources.#747: issuecomment-6190087365's probe families regenerated (widths 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16; bit and range reads and writes, both sides sliced, internal signals, chip-OUT reads, wire forms), and issuecomment-6190213877's end-to-end Or8Way table
